1.17.0.title: Listen in another language
1.17.0.detail: On a series page with transcripts, choose Hindi for an English series, English for a Hindi one, or another language. Apple Translation translates the transcript on your device and a system voice reads it. The wording may not be perfect.

1.17.0.title: At Osho's pace
1.17.0.detail: The voice pauses the way Osho does, so each paragraph takes about as long as in his talk.

1.17.0.title: Keeps translating while you listen
1.17.0.detail: Play the finished part while the rest translates. While the translation plays, translating continues in the background, even with the phone locked. Otherwise iOS stops it soon after you leave the app or lock the phone, and it continues from where it stopped when you come back.

1.17.0.title: The same moment in both
1.17.0.detail: Switch between the translation and Osho's recording without losing your place. Bookmarks save the moment in the recording.

1.17.0.title: Your last talk waits for you
1.17.0.detail: When you reopen the app, the last recording you were listening to is back in the mini-player, paused at your place.
